title: Baltimore vs Carolina: 2nd Half Point Spread

content.value: This market resolves to Yes if Carolina covers a -2.5 point spread against Baltimore during the 2nd half of the Pro Football game between Baltimore and Carolina scheduled for November 22, 2026 at 1:00 PM ET, meaning Carolina scores more than 2.5 points more than Baltimore during the 2nd half. Otherwise, it resolves to No. The Underlying counts only points scored by each team during the 2nd half, as documented by the official quarter-by-quarter scoring summary, and excludes overtime. Source Agencies, in order, are the league governing body, ESPN, Fox Sports, and the broadcast partner of the event. If the Expiration Value cannot be determined on the Expiration Date (including because the game is cancelled or a team forfeits, withdraws, or is disqualified), the Exchange may determine payouts pursuant to the Market Outcome Review Process. View the [full rules](https://assets.gemini.com/predictions/terms_and_conditions/TC_-_NFL_Period_Spread_c21fa9d6-31eb-42c4-9b16-30c420003993.pdf).
